mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions with temperatures sitting at 70 degrees at the Verona Community Park.

For those interested in local government, the City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election. All four Aldermanic Districts are on the ballot, and interested residents must submit their Declaration of Candidacy and other required forms to the City Clerk by January 5, 2027.
Currently, there are no specific upcoming events listed on the city calendar for the next 30 days, so it is a perfect time to explore our local community spaces.
In our weekly look at police activity, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash on November 3 at the intersection of CTH M and CTH PB, which resulted in one driver being transported to the hospital.
Culver's is ready to serve you the Mint Cookie flavor of the day, and they open today at 10:00 AM.
